name: r9-vectors-verifier-report
note: A member's signed verifier report (session-v1 R9.2 "How a verifier reports itself"; agreed for implementation on Astation #101, comment 7082464613): wire {"body":{…},"sig"}, the body {type: atem-verifier-report, v: 1, account_id, genesis_hash, head{seq, hash}, signer, slot, process, challenge{origin, connection, nonce, issued_at, expires_at}, verifier{version, actions}} signed by the signer's own key over enc(["atem-verifier-report-v1", jcs(body)]) (R9.1): a current native member's auth_key (signer member:<device_id>) or a current, unexpired service's own key (service:<device_id>), under the alg the device list pins. A challenge is what the minter issues and stores, {signer, slot, origin, connection, nonce, issued_at, expires_at}: signer member:<id> or service:<id>, slot and ids 1-128 bytes of [A-Za-z0-9._:-], origin exact as station_route::normalize_relay writes it, connection 1 to 2^53-1, nonce 32 bytes and process 16 bytes (base64url, no padding), 0 < expires_at - issued_at <= 30000 ms; a challenge text is at most 4,096 bytes; the body's jcs at most 4,096 bytes and the object at most 16 KiB; no null, no kit_sig, no field beyond these at any level, no duplicate key (escaped ones included). Device lists: log L of r9-vectors-membership-log followed by `chain` (labels of `entries`, signed by dev-mac), then the carriage `freeze` (a label of r9-vectors-membership-log's others) when a case names one, which freezes it; each list verified at the case's now_ms. Keys are r9-vectors-keys' (`signed_with` names <name>/<part>: auth, host_key, or recovery/sign for the kit's recovery key); dev-desk is the Ed25519 native the chain adds. `challenges`: texts read by ReportChallenge::parse (bindings parse_verifier_report_challenge): `fields` when read, else `code`. `valid` and `invalid`: verify_verifier_report(list, report, the stored challenge `challenge`, now_ms): `expect` is the VerifiedReport (kind native or service, process base64url, at_head true at the list's head, false at an ancestor), or `code`, the first failure in the order malformed, frozen, wrong_account, unknown_signer, signer_expired, bad_signature, stale_log, fork, signer_mismatch, slot_mismatch, challenge_mismatch, expired (bindings: Report{code}). A report's process is the fixed bytes "vectors-process!"; a builder draws its own once per loaded core (process_generation). `builder`: verifier_report_body(list, challenge, signer, slot, station, now_ms): `body_but_process` (the body it builds, but its process, which is the loaded core's), or `code` (origin_mismatch when the challenge's origin isn't station normalized). `request`: the immutable request (bindings VerifierReportRequest): built as a builder case, its sign_request (`purpose`, `fresh_confirmation`, `label`; input = enc([label, jcs(body)]), body_json = jcs(body)), then each `finishes` entry signs with `signed_with` the input of the held body (`over: held`) or of a request for the same challenge with another `slot` (`over: {slot}`), and finish gives the report, byte-equal to {"body":<held body>,"sig":<the signature, low S>}, or `code`.
